lines: Tum ko hum dil mein basa lenge, tum aao to sahi
couplets.en: I'll make a home for you in my heart, if only you come.

lines: Tum ko hum dil mein basa lenge, tum aao to sahi
couplets.en: I'll make a home for you in my heart, if only you come.

lines: Saari duniya se chhupa lenge, tum aao to sahi
couplets.en: I'll hide you from the whole world, if only you come.
For you, there is room in my heart.

lines: Ek waada karo, ab hum se na bichhroge kabhi
couplets.en: Promise me that from now on we'll never part.

lines: Naaz hum saare utha lenge, tum aao to sahi
couplets.en: I'll indulge your every whim, if only you come.

lines: Bewafa bhi ho, sitamgar bhi, jafa-pesha bhi
couplets.en: You're faithless and cruel, with a habit of causing hurt.

lines: Hum khuda tum ko bana lenge, tum aao to sahi
couplets.en: I'll worship you as my god, if only you come.

lines: Raah taareek hai aur door hai manzil, lekin
couplets.en: The road is dark and there is still so far to go.

lines: Dard ki sham'en jala lenge, tum aao to sahi
couplets.en: I'll light the candles of my sorrow, if only you come.
